name: My super mysterious kouhai is actually super sweet!!!
source:
In this game, you will play as Haruko Hidaka, a regular office worker trying to get to know her junior, Tsukiko Yonaga, who seems super mysterious but is always acting extra nice to her. As the game progresses, she will be able to know more about Tsukiko and the secret hidden behind her.

[From [url=https://amaibomb.itch.io/msmkiass]itch.io[/url]]
